summary: Harvard Apparatus Regenerative Technology filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026 covering a private placement in which investors bought 2,703,727 common shares at $1.05 per share for aggregate proceeds of $2,838,911. Included, CEO Jerry He converted $717,911 of bridge-note principal and interest into 683,725 shares at the same price, cancelling the April, May and July 2026 notes. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, close date or regulatory clock was stated; the unregistered issuance is the operative event. Watch for dilution, registration rights and any future financing overhang.
